title: finding(app-shell): `PageView` remounts the whole page after a page action by keying `InterfaceListPage` / `SchemaRenderer` on a `refreshKey` counter — the AGENTS.md §5 #8 shape objectui#10035 removed from both `ObjectView` layers
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it. The site is `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx`.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) at the ACCEPT of objectui#10035 (PR objectui#10494, comment `5827360925`). The at-tier contract review of that PR measured it with a repo-wide grep for counter-keyed subtrees. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

objectui AGENTS.md §5 commandment #8's corollary reads: "refresh data, don't rebuild UI — after a save/action, invalidate the affected data (`notifyDataChanged` from `@object-ui/react`) so consumers refetch in place; never bump a `key=` to remount a subtree".

PR objectui#10494 (merged `3759c568e`) removed the last counter keys from both `ObjectView` layers. One site of the same shape remains, read on objectui `origin/main`:

- `PageView` holds `const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0)`. The comment above it says the counter is "Threaded into the page context AND used to remount the renderer."
- `ConsoleActionRuntimeProvider`'s `onRefresh` bumps it: `onRefresh={() => setRefreshKey((k) => k + 1)}`.
- Both render branches are keyed on it: `<InterfaceListPage key={refreshKey} …>` (ADR-0047 interface mode) and `<SchemaRenderer key={refreshKey} …>`.

⇒ Every successful page-level action remounts the whole page. That destroys scroll, collapsed sections, tab state and in-progress edits, and it refetches every embedded block. This is the damage §5 #8 enumerates, and it is the mechanism objectui#10035 retired one layer down.

## What a fix has to measure (for triage, not a ruling)

- Which page-level actions reach `onRefresh`, and whether the data they change already reaches the embedded blocks through the invalidation bus. objectui#10035's `refreshData` now calls `notifyDataChanged`, so the same move may be enough here.
- `refreshKey` is also threaded into the page context (`context: { …, refreshKey }`). Check whether any page block reads it as its own refresh input before the key is dropped.
- Pins in the shape PR objectui#10494 used: after a page action, (a) the same renderer instance is kept, and (b) the embedded data is re-read.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (the search API answers 403 here), oldest updated 2026-09-18T10:20Z. Pattern `PageView … (refreshKey|key=)` or `InterfaceListPage … key` ⇒ 0 hits. Lit control `SystemHubPage` ⇒ 3 hits. ⇒ No duplicate.
